summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the sale of its interest in VodafoneZiggo Group Holding B.V. to Liberty Global Ltd. Consideration comprises €1.0 billion in cash and a 10% shareholding in Ziggo Group, which will own 100% of VodafoneZiggo and Liberty Global's Belgian unit Telenet. Vodafone will provide services including brand licensing to VodafoneZiggo for expected charges of €625 million over 10 years. Proceeds will reduce Vodafone's net debt. The transaction has closed; watch for any post-closing adjustments or integration developments.
